d: Native IRC client for the PS Vita: SSL, SASL, bouncer support, chat history, ChatGPT translation, Imgur uploads, a camera and an image viewer, in English and Spanish.
ld: A native, lightweight IRC client for the PlayStation Vita with free translation , image uploads , emoji and reactions , an image viewer and bouncer support.
